nodes.label: ItemsDB store
nodes.rationale: In-memory zero-dependency DB loaded from items-db JSON so worldgen/loot never pay an API call; query cache plus name/type/rarity indexes keep lookups cheap.

nodes.label: ItemsDB search/extract/filter
nodes.rationale: Exact then substring then bigram-cosine plus edit-distance rerank tolerates player typos without external search.
